'''GEMP''' is a browser rules engine for CCGs. The Star Wars CCG table used here descends from the same lineage as the Lord of the Rings TCG GEMP (Ketura / Player’s Council pattern): server-adjudicated play, not a physics sim.

* '''This instance''' — [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]. Independent table.
* '''Players Committee instance''' — gemp.starwarsccg.org. Not this site.

Work this table intends to add is listed on [[GEMP planned features]], including further [[Anything Goes]] rules and a [[True Sabacc]] game mode.

Card pages on this wiki will deep-link into play with a format query once URLs are stable (Phase 3 client hook). Do not scrape private PC GEMP endpoints.
